name: Cursor Trail
description: Drops images or stickers along the cursor path that pop in with a spring and shrink away; any ReactNode, spacing, lifetime and cap configurable.

props.name: items
props.description: What is dropped: images, stickers, emoji.

props.name: lifetime
props.description: Milliseconds before a drop shrinks away.
